descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S01 Empty patient list in Hospital and in both Nursing Home views: says so, offers a way to add, and the add control works

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Empty patient list: a clear empty state with a way to add patients (scan or "+"). (UAT EFS state 1; TFA-94745 state 1)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician on the local stack with no Hospital patients and no Nursing Home residents

When Open /rounding and wait for the list to finish loading; add 'QA EFS Add' with the empty list's own '+' control; switch to Nursing Home and look at Today's Visits, then All Residents; add 'QA EFS Add' with the Nursing Home '+' control

Then Each empty list says it has no patients / residents (not a blank area, not a spinner that never ends) and offers a way to add (scan or '+'); no error text. After adding through the empty list's own control, the new row shows and the empty message is gone without a reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U1: empty checkpoints (cp1, cp3, cp4) mustContain a statement that the list is empty ('no patients' / 'no residents') and 'scan', and mustNotContain error words; after-add checkpoints (cp2, cp5) mustContain 'QA EFS Add' and mustNotContain the empty message; post-run backend read: rounding:list length 1 and snf:list length 1, so a '+' that does nothing fails here. …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: probes.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S01

Empty patient list in Hospital and in both Nursing Home views: says so, offers a way to add, and the add control works

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane probes: status passed in probes/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): Scripted probe, fresh account, seed []: snapshot empty Hospital list, add via header '+' form, snapshot; Nursing Home Today's Visits + All Residents empty snapshots, add via the NH '+' icon button; checks on the aria snapshots (empty statement, 'scan', no error words, new row, empty message gone) + backend rounding:list / snf:list = 1 each. — All steps are UI + own-account reads; 'clear / existing style' stays a person's call from the screenshots (Q3).

Detail:

Empty Hospital list ('No patients on your list yet.' + '+'/camera hint), Today's Visits and All Residents each say they are empty, offer scan or '+', no error text; both '+' adds show the new row without a reload; backend rounding:list = 1, snf:list = 1. 'Clear / existing style' (Q3) stays a person's call from the screenshots.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs an account with no patients and no residents, and the agent adds 'QA EFS Add' itself: the dev account is shared and signed in once by Quinn (runner-contract §10.1), so its lists are not guaranteed empty, and a patient the agent adds carries no 'QA EFS-S01 ' prefix, so dev-cleanup.ts would n…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local datasets] passed (datasets/results.json) — datasets: passed → passed (passed) 12 judged cell(s) held
